chunks: And they ask you about menstruation. Say, 'It is a harm, so keep away from women during menstruation and do not approach them until they are pure. When they have purified themselves, then come to them as Allah has commanded you. Indeed, Allah loves those who repent and loves those who purify themselves.'

key_terms.تَطْهُرْنَ: They purify themselves (from major ritual impurity)

ai.seo_question: What is the Quranic ruling on sexual relations during menstruation?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this verse (Ayat al-Haid) serves as the foundational text for distinguishing between major ritual impurity (hadath akbar) and minor impurity (hadath asgar), thereby exempting women from daily prayers and fasting during menstruation while maintaining the prohibition of sexual intercourse. The phrase 'from where Allah has commanded you' is interpreted by scholars to include all marital relations except sexual intercourse, emphasizing that the state of purity (taharah) required for resuming intimacy is achieved through Ghusl al-Haid. This ruling underscores the holistic Islamic view where physical cleanliness is intrinsically linked to spiritual readiness and divine pleasure.
